title: Boston Gas Company submits a 365 Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Trigen-Boston Energy Corporation.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department approves the proposed Agreement and also grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure the pricing terms to be purchased under the Agreement, pursuant to G.L. c. 25 & 5D. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
